backend/main.mo: Motoko canister handling user profiles, product catalog with active/archived sets, and order placement with authorization checks.
feature_evidence.json: Feature‑to‑file mapping report showing which frontend files implement storefront, checkout, admin, and theming features.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing the purpose of each frontend file across components, pages, hooks, and config.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base styles defining OKLCH‑based industrial theme colors for light and dark modes.
frontend/index.html: Basic HTML entry point that loads the React application via main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Sets up TanStack Router, defines storefront and admin routes, and wraps the app with ThemeProvider and Toaster.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Footer with company info, quick links, social icons, and caffeine.ai attribution.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Header with logo, navigation links, and cart button showing item count.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Page layout wrapper combining Header, routed content, and Footer.
frontend/src/components/ProductCard.tsx: Displays a product’s image, name, description, price, and a link to its detail page.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and caches a backend actor based on user identity and refreshes dependent queries when it changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAdminOrders.ts: Provides hooks to fetch all orders and update order status using the backend actor with query invalidation.
frontend/src/hooks/useAdminProducts.ts: Provides hooks for fetching, creating, updating, archiving, and restoring products with automatic query invalidation.
frontend/src/hooks/useAuth.ts: Fetches the caller’s user role from the backend actor once available.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements Internet Identity auth context, managing login, stored identities, and status flags.
frontend/src/hooks/usePlaceOrder.ts: Defines a mutation hook to place an order and invalidate order queries afterward.
frontend/src/hooks/useProducts.ts: Fetches active products and individual product details from the backend actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind setup and custom CSS variables for light and dark theme styling.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with QueryClient and InternetIdentityProvider wrappers.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminLayout.tsx: Provides admin authentication gating and layout with navigation, handling login, role checks, and access restrictions.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminOrdersPage: Displays all orders in a table and allows admins to update order statuses with loading feedback.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminProductsPa: Manages product creation, editing, and archiving via dialogs and product tables with backend mutation hooks.
frontend/src/pages/CartPage.tsx: Displays cart items with quantity controls and navigation to checkout or products.
frontend/src/pages/CheckoutPage.tsx: Handles checkout form validation and submitting orders, then redirects to confirmation.
frontend/src/pages/OrderConfirmationPage: Shows a confirmation message and order ID after a successful purchase.
frontend/src/pages/ProductDetailPage.tsx: Displays detailed product info with quantity selection and add-to-cart handling, including loading and error states.
frontend/src/pages/StorefrontPage.tsx: Shows a storefront hero section and lists active products with loading, error, and empty states.
frontend/src/store/cart.ts: Zustand store for cart items supporting add, remove, quantity updates, total calculation, and persistence.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides helpers to read URL parameters (including hash routing), persist them in sessionStorage, and clear them from the URL or storage.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind with custom colors, typography, container settings, animations, and plugins for the app’s design system.
project_state.json: Defines the project’s current state, features, requirements, and image asset needs for the spray foam storefront application.
